newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - PhyCor started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - PhyCor started as buy.

text.p: -- Montgomery Securities said analyst Amy de Rham has started coverage of PhyCor Inc with a buy rating.
-- She expects earnings per share of $0.57 in fiscal 1996 and $0.80 in fiscal 1997.
-- Her target price on the stock is $45, about 25 percent above its current price.
-- PhyCor is a physicians management company with "one of the best earnings outlooks in the rapidly consolidating" doctors services market."
